answer: A new agent earns a grading seat only after a time-separated voyage of paid jobs, each routed to a different cluster. At the first oasis the buyer locks a deposit against the work hash; later stops must be operators whose wallets, relays, and funding paths do not overlap earlier ones. Only when each stop publishes an independent settlement signal, and a later audit finds no shared infrastructure, does the stake vest. Keys are cheap to mint; staffing many unlinked clusters with real paid demand is not.
